st: Ruby's Ranger Adventure // The Show Must Go On
d: During a camping trip in the forest, the Rainbow Village friends see a “monster” and almost cancel the trip. // When Princess Kiki chips her leg before a ballet performance, Rainbow Ruby must take the stage to save the day!

Thunderbell's scooter breaks, and he must deliver packages on foot, which is slow and painful. // When Ling Ling's group portrait gift is ruined, Rainbow Ruby secretly takes photos and surprises him with a photo album of all of their friends.
Honey Pie Pony is excited that the ponies of Ice Cream Island have invited her to take part in their annual Festival of the Horses.
Angel Cake likes everything 'just so' — and when things don’t go her way, she’s a pretty bad sport.
Peppermint Fizz is so determined to win the Nearly Once-A-Yearly Strawberryland Games.

st: Ginger Snap’s No-Light Night of Fright
d: When Strawberry & Friends go on an overnight campout, Ginger Snap doesn’t want them to find out, she’s afraid of the dark!
There’s someone…or something strange in the neighborhood, and the kids imagine the worst.
Strawberry is made to feel self-conscious about an old, patched-together raincoat that she has.
Peppermint Fizz wants to exclude a new girl, Blueberry Muffin, because she’s 'different' – in the way she looks, lives, talks, etc.

st: The Berry Best You Can Bee
d: Strawberry fills in at the bumblebee post office and learns that sometimes even when you try your very best, things don't always turn out as planned.
Strawberry struggles with how to be the berry best hostess when she has the very worst house guests.
Strawberry and her friends try to break a Berry Bitty World record to win a vacation for Berrykin Bloom.

Plum disregards Strawberry’s rule to sign up for use of the café, and is forced to reschedule a big dance recital. She holds a grudge and starts instigating wacky, nonsensical rules to prove rules are silly.
Berry Bitty City holds an election to see who will fill in as 'BerryFest Princess' while Princess Berrykin is absent.

st: At Your Service // A Hard Rain
d: When the restaurant is overrun with customers who aren't being served properly, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Waitress. // When Ruby's spilled marbles pour down on Rainbow Village, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Paramedic to treat the wounded.

Jessy's upset because everyone forgot the anniversary of the day she arrived in Rainbow Village. Rainbow Ruby becomes a Chef to cheer her up. // When Ling Ling's cold won't go away, Doctor Ruby discovers his problem is really allergies.

st: Behind the Scenes // Paperdoll in Peril
d: When nobody can understand what roles actors are playing in a performance, Rainbow Ruby designs costumes for the cast! // When Paige gets swept up on a windy day, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Firefighter to bring her to safety.

st: Singing in the Rain // Mail Carrier Mayhem
d: Rainbow Ruby becomes a Singer and puts on a concert that cheers everyone up!  // When Thunderbell forgets to mail invitations to his secret-swap-present party, Rainbow Ruby devises a plan to deliver them just in time.

st: Going Golfing // Case of the Stolen Spectacles
d: When the field is covered in pokey pods before a rainbow ball tournament, Rainbow Ruby creates a golf game to whack the pods out of the field. // When things go missing in Rainbow Village, it's up to Detective Rainbow Ruby and Choco to find the culprit.

st: Up in the Air // Addressing the Problem
d: Rainbow Ruby becomes a Pilot to help Chirpee see what it's like to fly, like other birds. //  Rainbow Ruby becomes a Fashion Designer and finds the perfect solution to Paige's fashion catastrophe.
Strawberry’s friend Coco Calypso lives on Seaberry Beach with her pet, Papaya Parrot, and a band of fun-loving monkeys.
A fantasy episode in which Strawberry, Rainbow Sherbet, Blueberry Muffin, Coco Calypso, and Seaberry Delight imagine themselves as Mermaids, drawn into a grand adventure.
Strawberry Shortcake’s friendship letter to children worldwide elicits Crepes Suzette's invitation to visit Pearis and the Pieffel Tower.
Friends from all over the world descend on Strawberryland to take part in the first Great Friendship Festival.

st: When the Berry Fairy Came to Stay
d: Out gathering berries one day, Strawberry & her pets find a tiny fairy among the berry vines.
One windy day, a tiny fairy named Sherry Bobbleberry gets blown into Strawberry’s open window.
Apple Dumplin’ wants to help Strawberry & her Friends with the baking.  But Dumplin’s just a little too little to be much help.  In fact, she ends up making a pretty big mess of things.

When Strawberry finds herself in charge of the upcoming BerryFest parade, she hopes her gal pals can help her with the overwhelming amounts of chores. But each of them is rather demanding and ungracious, so they're no use at all.
As this year's BerryFest Princess, Strawberry must learn to be a leader, and overcome many obstacles, to make sure the festival is a success.

st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
d: When there's a blackout in Berry Bitty City, Orange discovers she has a fear of what's in the dark: a Galumphalot.

st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
d: Blueberry spends all her time emulating her literary detective hero and ignores her friends, until Strawberry gives her a 'missing person case' to solve—the missing person being Blueberry herself!

To help Ellie overcome her stage fright, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Dance Teacher to help her friend take part in a dance-a-thon. // When the new fairy won't stop playing a game of hide-and-seek, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Baker to draw her out with the aroma.

When the rainbow friends try to make a movie starring Princess Kiki, they discover they need Rainbow Ruby to pull everything together and make it happen. // Rainbow Ruby realizes trying to get 3 tots back to sleep can be both frustrating and fun.

st: Wakey Wakey // Rules of the Road
d: Princess Kiki falls under a sleeping enchantment and needs a moving music box to cure her. // There's an epic traffic jam in Rainbow Village until Police Officer Rainbow Ruby arrives to help.

The Rainbow Village Annual Noodle Festival is in trouble. Rainbow Ruby becomes a Chef and makes noodles to save the day. // Ruby goes to Rainbow Village to help Gina get her confidence back by making her a star in the circus.

st: A Colorful Way to Cool Off // Seeing is Believing
d: When the rainbow fountain stops working, Rainbow Ruby becomes a Plumber and fixes the fountain so that everyone can cool off.  // Getting ready for her royal party, Kiki turns purple when she accidentally picks Plumenberries instead of Rainbow Berries.
